summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole to beat Talor Gooch and claim his first LIV Golf Korea title of 2026, his eighth LIV win overall, after both finished 12-under 268 at Asiad Country Club in Busan.

items.headline: Stout Leads NCAA Final Round
items.text: Oklahoma State junior Preston Stout holds a one-shot lead at 11-under after a third-round 65 at the NCAA Men's Golf Championship and is on track to secure an NCAA title and a probable Masters invite.
